ELESIS-COUNTER_ATTACK_POWER.title: Counter Attack
ELESIS-COUNTER_ATTACK_POWER.description: When attacked, deal {Power} fixed, blockable damage back to the attacker once for each hit received. It expires at Block cleanup.
ELESIS-COUNTER_ATTACK_POWER.smartDescrip: When attacked, deal {Power} fixed, blockable damage back to the attacker once for each hit received. It expires at Block cleanup.
ELESIS-BURN_POWER.title: Burn
ELESIS-BURN_POWER.description: Before this monster acts, it takes {Power} unblockable damage, then loses half of its Burn, rounded up.
ELESIS-BURN_POWER.smartDescription: Before this monster acts, it takes {Power} unblockable damage, then loses half of its Burn, rounded up.
ELESIS-EVER_READY_POWER.title: Ever Ready
ELESIS-EVER_READY_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Power} Counter Attack.
ELESIS-EVER_READY_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your turn, gain {Power} Counter Attack.
ELESIS-CINDER_ETCHING_POWER.title: Cinder Etching
ELESIS-CINDER_ETCHING_POWER.description: The first Attack that hits an enemy each turn applies {Power} Burn.
ELESIS-CINDER_ETCHING_POWER.smartDescrip: The first Attack that hits an enemy each turn applies {Power} Burn.
ELESIS-TEMPERED_RETORT_POWER.title: Tempered Retort
ELESIS-TEMPERED_RETORT_POWER.description: The first time each enemy takes Counter Attack damage during an enemy turn, apply {Power} Burn to it.
ELESIS-TEMPERED_RETORT_POWER.smartDescri: The first time each enemy takes Counter Attack damage during an enemy turn, apply {Power} Burn to it.
ELESIS-AEGIS_TEETH_POWER.title: Aegis Teeth
ELESIS-AEGIS_TEETH_POWER.description: Whenever you gain Block from a card, gain {Power} Counter Attack.
ELESIS-AEGIS_TEETH_POWER.smartDescriptio: Whenever you gain Block from a card, gain {Power} Counter Attack.
ELESIS-ASHEN_SHELTER_POWER.title: Ashen Shelter
ELESIS-ASHEN_SHELTER_POWER.description: Whenever Burn deals damage, gain {Power} Block.
ELESIS-ASHEN_SHELTER_POWER.smartDescript: Whenever Burn deals damage, gain {Power} Block.
ELESIS-PUNISHING_RHYTHM_POWER.title: Punishing Rhythm
ELESIS-PUNISHING_RHYTHM_POWER.descriptio: After the first attack hit you receive each enemy turn, gain {Power} Counter Attack for later hits.
ELESIS-PUNISHING_RHYTHM_POWER.smartDescr: After the first attack hit you receive each enemy turn, gain {Power} Counter Attack for later hits.
ELESIS-DEEP_SCORCH_POWER.title: Deep Scorch
ELESIS-DEEP_SCORCH_POWER.description: The first time you apply Burn each turn, apply {Power} additional Burn.
ELESIS-DEEP_SCORCH_POWER.smartDescriptio: The first time you apply Burn each turn, apply {Power} additional Burn.
ELESIS-FALLING_EMBERS_POWER.title: Falling Embers
ELESIS-FALLING_EMBERS_POWER.description: Whenever an enemy's Burn decays, apply {Power} Burn to another enemy. If there is no other enemy, apply 1 less Burn back to it instead.
ELESIS-FALLING_EMBERS_POWER.smartDescrip: Whenever an enemy's Burn decays, apply {Power} Burn to another enemy. If there is no other enemy, apply 1 less Burn back to it instead.
ELESIS-FURNACE_RAMPART_POWER.title: Furnace Rampart
ELESIS-FURNACE_RAMPART_POWER.description: At the start of the enemy turn, if you have Counter Attack, gain {Power} Block.
ELESIS-FURNACE_RAMPART_POWER.smartDescri: At the start of the enemy turn, if you have Counter Attack, gain {Power} Block.
ELESIS-UNFADING_GUARD_POWER.title: Unfading Guard
ELESIS-UNFADING_GUARD_POWER.description: At Block cleanup, lose only {Power} Counter Attack instead of all of it.
ELESIS-UNFADING_GUARD_POWER.smartDescrip: At Block cleanup, lose only {Power} Counter Attack instead of all of it.
ELESIS-BANKED_INFERNO_POWER.title: Banked Inferno
ELESIS-BANKED_INFERNO_POWER.description: When Burn decays, it loses 1/{Power} of its amount, rounded up, instead of half.
ELESIS-BANKED_INFERNO_POWER.smartDescrip: When Burn decays, it loses 1/{Power} of its amount, rounded up, instead of half.
ELESIS-HALL_OF_MIRRORS_POWER.title: Hall of Mirrors
ELESIS-HALL_OF_MIRRORS_POWER.description: Whenever Counter Attack damages an enemy, all other enemies take half that damage. If {Power} is 2 or more, they take the full amount instead.
ELESIS-HALL_OF_MIRRORS_POWER.smartDescri: Whenever Counter Attack damages an enemy, all other enemies take half that damage. If {Power} is 2 or more, they take the full amount instead.
ELESIS-PERSISTENT_BLAZE_POWER.title: Persistent Blaze
ELESIS-PERSISTENT_BLAZE_POWER.descriptio: At the start of your turn, apply {Power} Burn to all enemies.
ELESIS-PERSISTENT_BLAZE_POWER.smartDescr: At the start of your turn, apply {Power} Burn to all enemies.
ELESIS-ASHEN_TRIUMPH_POWER.title: Ashen Triumph
ELESIS-ASHEN_TRIUMPH_POWER.description: Up to {Power} times each turn, when Burn kills an enemy, gain 1 Energy and draw 2 cards.
ELESIS-ASHEN_TRIUMPH_POWER.smartDescript: Up to {Power} times each turn, when Burn kills an enemy, gain 1 Energy and draw 2 cards.
ELESIS-HEAT_IN_THE_WOUND_POWER.title: Heat in the Wound
ELESIS-HEAT_IN_THE_WOUND_POWER.descripti: Counter Attack deals 1 additional damage for every {Power} Burn on the attacker.
ELESIS-HEAT_IN_THE_WOUND_POWER.smartDesc: Counter Attack deals 1 additional damage for every {Power} Burn on the attacker.
ELESIS-PAIN_INTO_PLATE_POWER.title: Pain into Plate
ELESIS-PAIN_INTO_PLATE_POWER.description: The first time each enemy turn you take unblocked attack damage, gain Block equal to that damage, up to {Power}.
ELESIS-PAIN_INTO_PLATE_POWER.smartDescri: The first time each enemy turn you take unblocked attack damage, gain Block equal to that damage, up to {Power}.
ELESIS-AFTERBURN_POWER.title: Afterburn
ELESIS-AFTERBURN_POWER.description: After a burned enemy finishes an attack, it takes damage equal to half its remaining Burn without decay. If {Power} is 2 or more, it takes the full amount instead.
ELESIS-AFTERBURN_POWER.smartDescription: After a burned enemy finishes an attack, it takes damage equal to half its remaining Burn without decay. If {Power} is 2 or more, it takes the full amount instead.
ELESIS-PAIRED_RESOLVE_POWER.title: Paired Resolve
ELESIS-PAIRED_RESOLVE_POWER.description: Whenever a card applies Burn, gain {Power} Counter Attack once for that card.
ELESIS-PAIRED_RESOLVE_POWER.smartDescrip: Whenever a card applies Burn, gain {Power} Counter Attack once for that card.
ELESIS-REPRISAL_CUT_POWER.title: Reprisal Cut
ELESIS-REPRISAL_CUT_POWER.description: Your next Counter Attack before your next turn deals {Power} additional damage.
ELESIS-REPRISAL_CUT_POWER.smartDescripti: Your next Counter Attack before your next turn deals {Power} additional damage.
ELESIS-COUNTER_HISTORY_POWER.title: Answered Attack
ELESIS-COUNTER_HISTORY_POWER.description: Counter Attack dealt damage during the previous enemy turn.
ELESIS-COUNTER_HISTORY_POWER.smartDescri: Counter Attack dealt damage during the previous enemy turn.
ELESIS-BURN_STABILIZER_POWER.title: Burn Stabilizer
ELESIS-BURN_STABILIZER_POWER.description: The next time this enemy's Burn decays, it loses {Power} less Burn, to a minimum loss of 1.
ELESIS-BURN_STABILIZER_POWER.smartDescri: The next time this enemy's Burn decays, it loses {Power} less Burn, to a minimum loss of 1.
ELESIS-SEALED_COUNTER_POWER.title: Sealed Counter
ELESIS-SEALED_COUNTER_POWER.description: Counter Attack does not expire at the next Block cleanup.
ELESIS-SEALED_COUNTER_POWER.smartDescrip: Counter Attack does not expire at the next Block cleanup.
ELESIS-DOUBLE_COUNTER_POWER.title: Double Counter
ELESIS-DOUBLE_COUNTER_POWER.description: The next {Power} times Counter Attack triggers before your next turn, it deals damage twice.
ELESIS-DOUBLE_COUNTER_POWER.smartDescrip: The next {Power} times Counter Attack triggers before your next turn, it deals damage twice.
ELESIS-COUNTER_RETENTION_POWER.title: Counter Retention
ELESIS-COUNTER_RETENTION_POWER.descripti: At the next Block cleanup, retain up to {Power} Counter Attack.
ELESIS-COUNTER_RETENTION_POWER.smartDesc: At the next Block cleanup, retain up to {Power} Counter Attack.
ELESIS-REDIRECTION_POWER.title: Redirection
ELESIS-REDIRECTION_POWER.description: The next enemy attack that hits you before your next turn applies {Power} Burn to its attacker.
ELESIS-REDIRECTION_POWER.smartDescriptio: The next enemy attack that hits you before your next turn applies {Power} Burn to its attacker.
ELESIS-SMOLDERING_GUARD_POWER.title: Smoldering Guard
ELESIS-SMOLDERING_GUARD_POWER.descriptio: The next enemy attack that breaks your Block before your next turn applies {Power} Burn to its attacker.
ELESIS-SMOLDERING_GUARD_POWER.smartDescr: The next enemy attack that breaks your Block before your next turn applies {Power} Burn to its attacker.
ELESIS-AGGRESSOR_BRAND_POWER.title: Aggressor Brand
ELESIS-AGGRESSOR_BRAND_POWER.description: Each attack hit this enemy deals before the end of its turn applies {Power} Burn to it.
ELESIS-AGGRESSOR_BRAND_POWER.smartDescri: Each attack hit this enemy deals before the end of its turn applies {Power} Burn to it.
